name: Residencia Definitiva

requirements.blocker_text: At least 24 months holding a valid Residencia Temporal permit (for applications submitted after 14 May 2022).
requirements.fix_path: Hold Residencia Temporal continuously for 24 months.

requirements.blocker_text: Application must be submitted within the 90-day window before the Residencia Temporal permit expires.

One of: family connections to a Chilean national or Residencia Definitiva holder; completed official diplomatic mission; proven income or pension; active business investment in Chile; notable social/cultural/artistic/scientific/sports contribution; or eligibility under an international agreement -- reduces the wait to 12 months.

evidence_required.document: Proof of income/livelihood (varies by employment status)

sources.title: serviciomigraciones.cl (SERMIG) -- Residencia Definitiva: standard 24 months as a Residencia Temporal holder (applications after 14 May 2022), reduced to 12 months for family ties/diplomatic service/proven income/business investment/notable contributions/international agreements, and extended beyond 24 months for insufficient means, unstable employment, extended absences, or legal violations

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chile). Modeled PUBLISHED -- directly and comprehensively tier-1 sourced, one of the strongest files in this build. The reduced (12-month) and extended (beyond 24-month) tracks are both disclosed by SERMIG's own page; the EXTENDED track (for insufficient means, unstable employment, extended absences, or legal/tax/labour violations) is not modeled as a separate requirement group since it describes circumstances that lengthen the wait rather than a distinct qualifying path -- disclosed here in notes rather than omitted. Fee amount was referenced by the source as applying but not quantified, and is not stated here.
